reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the label: 200 mg per sachet, no oxide and a QR for the lab report, which is better than most. But I already take magnesium at night at home and have a drawer of half-used bottles, so paying $29.99 for a pretty sachet to carry around makes no sense for me.
objection: I don't travel with my magnesium, I take it at home at night. $29.99 a month is a lot for packaging when a plain bottle of bisglycinate costs me much less.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 to $18 for 30 days, or a cheaper small trial pack so I could see if it is actually better than what I already have.
